summary: The common damage setup (Death on every statue, twelve Wisdom and Illusion artworks), with the statues that pair Death with Freedom: a Ranger shoots the boss from the front, where Accuracy decides how often it blocks or parries. At the Accuracy cap, switch to the Death and Space statues. The PvP preset keeps Freedom for Evasion against melee players.

presets.name: PvE

priority.why: Smite doubles a hit; J0EI calls it king on Global, which has few other Double Chance sources.
Combat Speed up to the 88.1% step with Gale Arrow; past that step it adds little.
Attack Increase, a multiplier on all your Attack.
Cooldown Reduction for Vaizel's Authority, Bow of Blessing and Deadshot. GuideMMO aims for 33% or more.
Critical Hit, but at about 40% under Precision you reach the 50% cap whenever Bow of Blessing is up.
Accuracy against the boss's Block and Parry until you reach the cap.
Perfect chance, once the lines above are covered.
Move Speed: nice for kiting, no damage.

presets.statueWhy: The Freedom-leaning set: Bakarma, Artifact of Eternity, Dream Fragment and Fafnir's Poison Blood each pair Death with Freedom (38 Death, 38 Freedom, 12 Space). You shoot the boss from the front, so its Block and Parry apply and Accuracy cancels them one for one up to the cap.[kr] Korean top Rangers stack far more Accuracy on their jewellery than Assassins do.[/kr] The two Rare pieces cost 4 Death against the Epic Asahr's Mirror and Notun, which pair Death with Space. Once you're at the Accuracy cap, switch to Bakarma, Asahr's Mirror, Notun and Artifact of Eternity, the most Death you can have (42).
presets.artworkWhy: Take every Wisdom and Illusion artwork you can: neither Destiny nor Life adds damage. Every Unique artwork with both Wisdom and Illusion has a fixed third stat, so no set is all Destiny or all Life: Krao, Ferocious Horn Den and the five Destiny elite pieces add Destiny, Vakron Sky Island, Draupnir, Divine Ansas and Phantasm Kasia add Life, and Gartua adds both (33 Destiny and 21 Life in all). Asmodians have four of the Destiny elite pieces (Kaira, Guruta, Shylak, Newbold) and no Life ones of their own: they fill the last three slots with Epic Wisdom and Illusion artworks, or buy Divine Ansas and Phantasm Kasia on the Market or reach them through a rift.
presets.braceletWhy: Time and Wisdom first, then Destruction and Illusion. For a fifth line, Death if you're under the crit cap or Freedom if you're short on Accuracy, then Justice.[kr] Korean Rangers argue on Inven over dropping Destruction, Death or Freedom for Justice once they reach their caps.[/kr]
presets.note: Guardian Lord Nahma's colossus is rarely sold; Zikel's Apparition (Nightmare shop, 14,000 Phantasmal Fragments) gives the same three stats at 45 and is the realistic one. The artworks are the Elyos set.

presets.name: PvP

priority.why: Combat Speed for more arrows inside a Precision window.
Accuracy counts against players (PvE Accuracy doesn't), and Evasion keeps melee classes off you.
Cooldown Reduction for your escapes and burst, and Endurance Penetration.
Crit lands far less often on players (about 29% in one duel test), and it pierces Regeneration.
HP and Regeneration for when someone reaches you.

presets.statueWhy: The same Death and Freedom statues: Accuracy and Evasion both count against players, and Evasion keeps melee classes off you.[kr] Korean PvP Rangers often run Evasion builds and keep Freedom on their bracelets for it.[/kr]
presets.artworkWhy: The same artworks as PvE: Smite builds keep their Wisdom pieces in PvP, and the fixed mix brings 21 Life (HP and Regeneration) and 33 Destiny (Endurance) with them. Asmodians have four of the Destiny elite pieces (Kaira, Guruta, Shylak, Newbold) and no Life ones of their own: they fill the last three slots with Epic Wisdom and Illusion artworks, or buy Divine Ansas and Phantasm Kasia on the Market or reach them through a rift.
presets.braceletWhy: Time and Freedom first.[kr] A Korean PvP Ranger's fixed lines are Time, Freedom, Life, Illusion and Destruction, with Death or Justice last.[/kr]
presets.note: For a tankier Endurance preset, swap the two Life expedition pieces and one elite piece for Guardian Lord Nahma's artwork and the two PvP artworks (Argo, and Ardus Shrine or Impetusium), which carry Illusion, Destiny and Life but no Wisdom. Players do this mainly on tanks; no source recommends it for Rangers.

arcana: The planner's cards give Time (Chalice of Vigor), Life (Parchment of Vigor), Death (Compass of Magic), Destruction (Bell of Magic) and Wisdom (Mirror of Magic), up to 20 each, so four of the five feed damage. The Compass of Magic's Death stops paying at the crit cap, which a Ranger reaches under Bow of Blessing. If you're short on Accuracy instead, the Compass of Vigor (Freedom) is the swap, and it is the usual PvP card. Keep the Mirror of Magic: its Wisdom also cuts MP costs.[kr] A Korean Ranger who switched to the Mirror of Vigor ran out of MP.[/kr][kr] Korean top Rangers wear the Compass of Magic in PvE (84%) and the Compass of Vigor in PvP (71%).[/kr] Among Global's top 100 Rangers, 93% wear the Bell of Magic, 92% the Chalice of Vigor and 78% the Parchment of Vigor.
tips: No top-100 Global Ranger wears an Abyssal Bracelet yet (they wear the Ascension Bracelet with a Liberator or Pilgrim one), so the bracelet lines are for later.
Bow of Blessing and Precision add Critical Hit while they're up: count them toward the 50% crit cap before you add Death.
Check your Combat Speed against the 88.1% Gale Arrow step before you add Time.

Once you reach the Accuracy cap, swap Dream Fragment and Fafnir's Poison Blood for Asahr's Mirror and Notun: Pantheon presets are free to switch. The 5,000-fragment Nightmare statues are Rare, no better than the quest ones; Notun (8,000) is the one worth buying.
Fill all twelve artwork slots first. The Krao, Vakron Sky Island, Draupnir and Ferocious Horn Den artworks are the cheapest Unique ones with both Wisdom and Illusion on the Market.
Start saving Phantasmal Fragments early: Zikel's Apparition costs 14,000, and players run short after buying Stigma Shards and Daevanion crystals.

disagree: Freedom or Space: Aion 2 Maps leaves it open and Game8 takes Space. This page takes Freedom in PvE until the Accuracy cap, because a Ranger hits from the front, GuideMMO and Aion 2 Maps both build Accuracy on gear until the cap[kr], and Korean top Rangers stack it[/kr]. Game8 ranks Destruction and Illusion first and leaves Wisdom off, and Game8 and Wakayashi put Kibelisk (no Death) in a statue slot. This page follows Aion 2 Maps, GuideMMO and AION2 Vault, which put Wisdom first, and keeps Death on all four statues; a Ranger already crit-capped outside Bow of Blessing could take Kibelisk or Gerod instead. For the fifth bracelet line, Aion 2 Maps takes Death or Justice and GuideMMO Death or Freedom.
